content.short: Caddi is a money-saving crypto extension that helps users find the best prices and block malicious transactions.
content.description: Caddi helps users navigate the fragmented and inefficient on-chain trading world by simplifying access to value within decentralized finance and guarding against scams. After installation, the browser extension intercepts swaps on DEXs and aggregators before they reach the wallet, enabling users to find the best price across DeFi and CeFi and to block potentially malicious transactions, delivering a safer and more streamlined trading experience.
content.meta: Caddi streamlines on-chain trading, enhancing access to value in DeFi and guarding against scams. Discover Caddi and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: An Extension That Checks Your Swap
resources.tldr: It intercepts a trade before it reaches the wallet, compares prices across venues, and blocks transactions that look malicious.
